intro.text: A noble commander who fights in the defence of Luthadel against the koloss.

items.text: Culee led Battalion Sixteen at the Steel Gate, where Sazed was watching the fighting. When Lord Penrod called for reinforcements at the Pewter Gate, the target of much of the koloss assault, Culee marched off with six of his ten companies and most of his best soldiers. The Steel Gate was left badly undermanned, with the inexperienced Captain Bedes in charge of the four hundred men who stayed behind.
